bosses.name: Pyroguard Emberseer
loot: Formula: Molten Heart of the Mountain
bosses.description: Hall of Binding: use the altar to wake him once the Blackhand Incarcerators are dead.

bosses.name: Solakar Flamewreath
bosses.description: The Rookery: touch the Father Flame and fight off the whelp waves until he arrives.

bosses.name: Jed Runewatcher
bosses.description: Rare: sometimes waits in the hall before the Blackrock Stadium.

bosses.name: Goraluk Anvilcrack
bosses.description: Dark Horde blacksmith. Use the Blood Stained Pike on him for The Demon Forge.

bosses.name: Gyth
bosses.description: Blackrock Stadium: Rend's black dragon, released after the arena waves.

bosses.name: Warchief Rend Blackhand
bosses.description: Rides Gyth into the Blackrock Stadium and jumps off when the dragon is low.

bosses.name: The Beast
bosses.description: Giant core hound in its den past the Stadium. Fights back with fireballs and fear.

bosses.name: Lord Valthalak
bosses.description: Summoned with the Brazier of Beckoning from the Dungeon Set 2 quests.

bosses.name: General Drakkisath
bosses.description: Final boss, in the throne room with his two Chromatic Elite Guards. Guards Drakkisath's Brand.

entrance.label: Upper Blackrock Spire Entrance
entrance.detail: Blackrock Mountain, between Searing Gorge and the Burning Steppes: climb to the upper ledge to the Blackrock Spire portal, then through Lower Blackrock Spire to the sealed door

quests.name: Seal of Ascension
quests.objective: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake Emberstrife and beat him until his will is broken, place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before him, then use the Orb of Draconic Energy on him and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension.
quests.note: Take the Unforged Seal and the Orb of Draconic Energy to Emberstrife in the Wyrmbog, Dustwallow Marsh. The forged seal opens the UBRS door.

startItem: Dropped by the Scarshield Quartermaster in the hallway outside the Spire portal
quests.objective: Find the brand that General Drakkisath guards and gain the Mark of Drakkisath, so you can use the Orb of Command.
quests.pickup: Blackhand's Command (letter from the Scarshield Quartermaster, Blackrock Mountain)
quests.note: The Scarshield Quartermaster is in the hallway outside the Spire portal. Touch Drakkisath's Brand behind General Drakkisath; this unlocks the Orb of Command shortcut to Blackwing Lair.
quests.name: Blackhand's Command
Egg Collection
quests.turnin: Tinkee Steamboil, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes
quests.objective: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
quests.pickup: Tinkee Steamboil, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes
quests.note: Using the module on the eggs in the Rookery can hatch whelps.

quests.name: General Drakkisath's Demise
quests.turnin: Marshal Maxwell, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.
quests.pickup: Marshal Maxwell, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.note: Kill General Drakkisath at the end of UBRS.

quests.name: For The Horde!
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Oculus Illusions
quests.turnin: Myranda the Hag, Sorrow Hill, Western Plaguelands
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.
quests.pickup: Myranda the Hag, Sorrow Hill, Western Plaguelands
quests.note: Part of the Horde Onyxia chain. Black Dragonspawn Eyes drop from the dragonspawn in UBRS.

quests.name: Drakefire Amulet
quests.objective: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.
quests.note: Part of the Onyxia attunement.

quests.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.
quests.note: Part of the Onyxia attunement.

quests.name: The Demon Forge
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire, slay Goraluk Anvilcrack and use the Blood Stained Pike on his corpse. Also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate. Return the Soul Stained Pike and the breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.
quests.note: Blacksmithing 270 (Armorsmith). Use the Blood Stained Pike on Goraluk's corpse and loot the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate nearby.

quests.name: Mayara Brightwing
quests.turnin: Mayara Brightwing, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.warning: OPTIONAL, not required
quests.objective: Speak with Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.
quests.note: Introductory step leading to Doomrigger's Clasp.

quests.name: Doomrigger's Clasp
quests.objective: Bring Doomrigger's Clasp to Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.
quests.pickup: Mayara Brightwing, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.note:
Doomrigger's Coffer is in the Rookery. Then take Delivery to Ridgewell to Count Remington Ridgewell in Stormwind Keep for the reward.

Optional introductory quest:
quests.turnin: Mayara Brightwing, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes

quests.name: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet
quests.warning: OPTIONAL, not required
quests.objective: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave.
quests.note: Introductory step leading to The Darkstone Tablet.

quests.name: The Darkstone Tablet

noteQuestLink.name: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet

quests.objective: Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
quests.note:
The Darkstone Tablet lies on the ground in the Rookery.

Optional introductory quest:

quests.name: Finkle Einhorn, At Your Service!
quests.objective: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.
quests.pickup: From The Beast's corpse, Upper Blackrock Spire
quests.note: He appears from The Beast's corpse after the fight. Malyfous then offers the Pristine Hide of the Beast exchanges.

quests.name: The Matron Protectorate
quests.objective: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.
quests.note: Awbee is the wounded blue dragon near the arena route after Rend. Use the rune deep in the Mazthoril cave to reach Haleh.

Upper Blackrock Spire.description: The top of Blackrock Spire, held by Rend Blackhand's Dark Horde and General Drakkisath's black dragonflight. The door needs the Seal of Ascension.

bosses.name: High Interrogator Gerstahn
bosses.description: Detention Block. Drops the Prison Cell Key.

bosses.name: Lord Roccor
loot: Formula: Smoking Heart of the Mountain
bosses.description: Earth elemental on the ring above the Detention Block.

bosses.name: Houndmaster Grebmar
bosses.description: Kennel master with his hounds on the ring above the Detention Block.

bosses.name: Gorosh the Dervish
bosses.description: Ring of Law: one of six possible challengers.

bosses.name: Grizzle
bosses.description: Ring of Law: one of six possible challengers.

bosses.name: Eviscerator
bosses.description: Ring of Law: one of six possible challengers.

bosses.name: Ok'thor the Breaker
bosses.description: Ring of Law: one of six possible challengers.

bosses.name: Anub'shiah
bosses.description: Ring of Law: one of six possible challengers.

bosses.name: Hedrum the Creeper
bosses.description: Ring of Law: one of six possible challengers.

bosses.name: Theldren
bosses.description: Ring of Law: use the Banner of Provocation in the arena to challenge him and his gladiators. Lefty's Brass Knuckle and Malgen's Long Bow come from the Arena Spoils chest after the fight.

bosses.name: Pyromancer Loregrain
bosses.description: Shrine of Thaurissan, behind the Ring of Law.

bosses.name: Fineous Darkvire
bosses.description: Hall of Crafting. Drops Ironfel for Dark Iron Legacy.

bosses.name: Warder Stilgiss
bosses.description: In the vault with his pet Verek, after the six Dark Keepers.

bosses.name: Secret Safe
bosses.description: In the Black Vault: open all 12 lockers with Relic Coffer Keys (they drop in Blackrock Depths) and Watchman Doomgrip appears. Defeat him and the Secret Safe opens; it holds one of these.

bosses.name: Lord Incendius
bosses.description: The Black Anvil in the Black Forge.

bosses.name: Bael'Gar
bosses.description: Fire giant at the end of the Dark Iron Highway.

bosses.name: General Angerforge
bosses.description: West Garrison; calls for help at low health.

bosses.name: Golem Lord Argelmach
bosses.description: Manufactory, north of the West Garrison.

bosses.name: Hurley Blackbreath
bosses.description: Grim Guzzler: break the Thunderbrew kegs to make him appear.

bosses.name: Phalanx
bosses.description: Comes to life at the Grim Guzzler door after Hurley or the bar fight.

bosses.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
bosses.description: Grim Guzzler. Kill him for Yuka Screwspigot's bounty.

bosses.name: Plugger Spazzring
bosses.description: Grim Guzzler barkeep; turns hostile if you steal his ale.

bosses.name: Ambassador Flamelash
bosses.description: Chamber of Enchantment; keep the Burning Spirits off him.

bosses.name: Panzor the Invincible
bosses.description: Rare golem that can replace the guards around the West Garrison.

bosses.name: The Seven
bosses.description: Summoners' Tomb: talk to Doom'rel and defeat the seven dwarf spirits one after another. Loot is in the Chest of The Seven.

bosses.name: Magmus
bosses.description: Guards the door to the Imperial Seat; the braziers shoot fire while he lives.

bosses.name: Princess Moira Bronzebeard
bosses.description: Heals the Emperor. Don't kill her if you are on the Royal Rescue or Fate of the Kingdom quest.

bosses.name: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan
bosses.description: Final boss, on the throne of the Imperial Seat.

entrance.label: Blackrock Depths Entrance
entrance.detail: Blackrock Mountain, between Searing Gorge and the Burning Steppes: take the chain down from the Blackrock Spire ledge and follow the lower path to the Depths portal

quests.name: Dark Iron Legacy
quests.objective: Slay Fineous Darkvire and recover the great hammer, Ironfel. Take Ironfel to the Shrine of Thaurissan and place it on the statue of Franclorn Forgewright.
quests.note: Speak to Franclorn's ghost while dead. Kill Fineous Darkvire for Ironfel and place it on Franclorn's monument by the Ring of Law. The Shadowforge Key opens shortcuts inside BRD.

quests.name: The Heart of the Mountain
quests.objective: Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.
quests.note: The Heart of the Mountain is in the vault safe after the Dark Keepers.

quests.name: The Spectral Chalice
quests.objective: Bring Gloom'rel 2 Star Rubies, 20 Gold Bars and 10 Truesilver Bars, then place them in the Spectral Chalice in the Summoners' Tomb.
quests.note: Mining 230. Talk to Gloom'rel before the Seven fight; give the Spectral Chalice 2 Star Rubies, 20 Gold Bars and 10 Truesilver Bars to learn Smelt Dark Iron.

quests.name: Yuka Screwspigot
quests.turnin: Yuka Screwspigot, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes
quests.warning: OPTIONAL, not required
quests.objective: Speak with Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.
quests.note: Introductory step leading to Ribbly Screwspigot.

quests.name: Ribbly Screwspigot
quests.objective: Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.
quests.pickup: Yuka Screwspigot, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes
quests.note: Optional introductory quest:
quests.turnin: Yuka Screwspigot, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes

quests.name: The Love Potion
quests.objective: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.
quests.note: Gromsblood, Giant Silver Veins (Azshara cliff giants) and the vial filled at Golakka Hot Springs in Un'Goro. Opens a peaceful way through the bar on later visits.

quests.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
quests.warning: OPTIONAL, not required
quests.objective: Speak with Ragnar Thunderbrew.
quests.pickup: Enohar Thunderbrew, Nethergarde Keep, Blasted Lands
quests.note: Introductory step leading to Hurley Blackbreath.

quests.name: Hurley Blackbreath
quests.objective: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.
quests.note:
Break the three kegs in the Grim Guzzler storeroom to spawn Hurley Blackbreath and his guards.

Optional introductory quest:

quests.name: Vivian Lagrave
quests.warning: OPTIONAL, not required
quests.objective: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
quests.note: Introductory step leading to Lost Thunderbrew Recipe.

quests.name: Lost Thunderbrew Recipe
quests.objective: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
quests.note:
Break the three kegs in the Grim Guzzler storeroom to spawn Hurley Blackbreath and his guards.

Optional introductory quest:

quests.name: Incendius!
quests.turnin: Jalinda Sprig, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.objective: Find Lord Incendius in Blackrock Depths and destroy him!
quests.pickup: Jalinda Sprig, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.note: Kill Lord Incendius at the Black Anvil inside BRD.

quests.name: Disharmony of Fire
quests.objective: Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.
quests.note: Kill Lord Incendius at the Black Anvil inside BRD and bring back the Tablet of Kurniya.

quests.name: The Last Element
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.
quests.note: Essence of the Elements drops from BRD elementals and golems.

quests.name: Jail Break!
quests.turnin: Marshal Maxwell, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.objective: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.
quests.note: Escort Marshal Windsor through the prison. Clear the patrols first and have everyone ready before you start.

quests.name: What Is Going On?
quests.objective: Defend Gor'shak.
quests.note: Open his cell with the Prison Cell Key from High Interrogator Gerstahn, then defend him.

quests.name: The Rise of the Machines
quests.objective: Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach.
quests.note: Kill Golem Lord Argelmach for his head and collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the constructs guarding him.

quests.name: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
quests.objective: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors! Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.
startObject: On the wall in Kargath, Badlands

quests.name: KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials
quests.objective: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors! Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.
startObject: On the wall in Kargath, Badlands

quests.name: Operation: Death to Angerforge
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.
quests.note: Needs both KILL ON SIGHT quests and the Grark Lorkrub escort first.

quests.name: A Taste of Flame
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar. Use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence. Return the Encased Fiery Essence to Cyrus Therepentous.
providedItem: Given by Cyrus Therepentous when you accept the quest
requiredItem: From Bael'Gar's remains: use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on them
quests.note: Kill Bael'Gar, then use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on his remains to collect the Encased Fiery Essence.

quests.name: The Fate of the Kingdom
quests.objective: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.
quests.note: Keep Princess Moira alive and speak to her after Emperor Thaurissan dies. Her The Princess's Surprise sends you back to Magni for the reward.

quests.name: The Royal Rescue
quests.objective: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.
quests.note: Keep Princess Moira alive and speak to her after Emperor Thaurissan dies. Her The Princess Saved? sends you back to Thrall for the reward.

quests.name: The Good Stuff
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.
quests.note: Dark Iron Fanny Packs drop from Dark Iron dwarves in BRD.

quests.name: Attunement to the Core
quests.objective: Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment. Return to Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain when you have recovered the Core Fragment.
quests.note: The Core Fragment is on the rock beside the Molten Core portal deep inside BRD. Unlocks Lothos's teleport to Molten Core.

quests.name: A Binding Contract
quests.turnin: Lokhtos Darkbargainer, Grim Guzzler, Blackrock Depths
quests.objective: Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.
quests.pickup: Thorium Brotherhood Contract (from Lokhtos Darkbargainer with a Sulfuron Ingot)
quests.note: Blacksmithing. Bring a Sulfuron Ingot (Golemagg, Molten Core) to Lokhtos in the Grim Guzzler to get the contract, then hand it back for the Sulfuron Hammer plans.

quests.name: Fragment of the Firelands
quests.objective: Recover a Fragment of the Firelands from Magmus in Blackrock Depths for Alaana Stormwalker in Mulgore.
quests.note: The Fragment of the Firelands drops from Magmus, the guardian at the door to the Imperial Seat in Blackrock Depths. Seen picked up at level 49.
requiredItems: Drops from Magmus in Blackrock Depths
quests.rewards: 14,800 XP • 85s • Cenarion Circle +300

startMap.label: Alaana Stormwalker — Skywatcher Plateau
startMap.detail: Where the skycutter lands, northwest of Thunder Bluff

quests.name: Ever After
quests.objective: Speak with the Rugged Traveler.
quests.pickup: Rugged Traveler, on a hidden ledge above the lava, Blackrock Depths
quests.note: Take the bridge just east of the Ring of Law that runs north over the lava and clear it. On its left side, by the small brazier, jump from the railing onto the platform against the wall, follow it to the corner and keep your left shoulder on the wall until you drop onto the rock ledge below: the Rugged Traveler is there. The door on the ledge takes you to a ledge above Lord Incendius; there is no way back. Not shareable.

quests.name: Materials of Significance
quests.warning: Long chain quest: part of the Alliance Paladin storyline that also has A Brother In Need
quests.objective: Use the hints in Gregory's Note to determine where to find the magical components needed for the ritual. You will need help from allies for this.

requiredItems.4: Dropped by the infernals (Infernal Bodyguards, Infernal Sentries) in Shatter Scar Vale, northern Felwood
From the grave mound in Princess Theradras's area of Maraudon
Bought from Plugger Spazzring in the Grim Guzzler, Blackrock Depths
Reward from the quest A Newly Discovered Purpose...: Brave Stonetorch, Hillsbrad Foothills (67.4, 14.8)

providedItem: Given by Gregory when you accept the quest
quests.note: Alliance Paladin quest. How to unlock it: The Bloody Missive, then In Search of Aeonas (at the Emerald Sanctuary interact with Aeonas's horse first, then follow his trail), then speak with Aeonas and Gregory in Felwood: Gregory offers Materials of Significance. Its parts come from Felwood, Maraudon, Blackrock Depths and Hillsbrad Foothills.

Blackrock Depths.description: The capital of the Dark Iron dwarves beneath Blackrock Mountain: the Detention Block, the Ring of Law, the Grim Guzzler and Shadowforge City, ruled by Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

bosses.name: Guard Mol'dar
bosses.description: Ogre guard at the entrance of Gordok Commons.

bosses.name: Stomper Kreeg
bosses.description: Drunk ogre brewer; after the Tribute Run he sells the Gordok brews.

bosses.name: Guard Fengus
bosses.description: Ogre guard in the courtyard.

bosses.name: Guard Slip'kik
bosses.description: Ogre guard behind the trap; the Gordok Ogre Suit lets you walk past him.

bosses.name: Captain Kromcrush
bosses.description: Gives Unfinished Gordok Business; with the Ogre Suit you can talk to him instead of fighting.

bosses.name: Cho'Rush the Observer
bosses.description: Ogre mage fought together with King Gordok.

bosses.name: King Gordok
bosses.description: Final boss. Killing him makes you the new Gordok king and opens the tribute chest.

bosses.name: Gordok Tribute Chest
bosses.description: Tribute chest awarded by Mizzle the Crafty after King Gordok is defeated. The tribute improves when Gordok guards and Captain Kromcrush are spared. Equipment pool is based on Classic-derived Forever reference data; individual drops still need live verification.

entrance.label: Dire Maul Entrance
entrance.detail: Central Feralas, inside the ruins of Eldre'Thalas: the North (Gordok) wing door, opened with the Crescent Key

quests.name: Unfinished Gordok Business
quests.objective: Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul. According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.
quests.note: Talk to a friendly Captain Kromcrush after you become the Gordok king. The Gauntlet of Gordok Might is in a chest near Prince Tortheldrin in Dire Maul West.

quests.name: Free Knot!
quests.objective: Find a Gordok Shackle Key on the ogres of the Gordok wing and use it to free Knot Thimblejack.
quests.note: Get a Gordok Shackle Key from the North ogres and free Knot; his cache has loot.

quests.name: The Gordok Ogre Suit
quests.objective: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.
quests.note: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads and 1 Ogre Tannin (basket on the upper level beyond Knot). Make any suits and learn the pattern before freeing Knot, because he leaves.

quests.name: Elven Legends
quests.objective: Search Dire Maul for Kariel Winthalus. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.
quests.note: Interact with the Skeletal Remains of Telmius Dreamseeker beside Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum. Unlocks Lydros's libram exchanges.

quests.name: Elven Legends
quests.objective: Search Dire Maul for Kariel Winthalus. Report back to Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache with whatever information that you may find.
quests.note: Interact with the Skeletal Remains of Telmius Dreamseeker beside Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum. Unlocks Lydros's libram exchanges.

Nostro's Compendium
quests.objective: Return Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying to the Athenaeum.
quests.pickup: Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying (rare Dire Maul drop)
quests.note: Warriors and Paladins. Lydros then gives The Forging of Quel'Serrar, which is finished in Onyxia's Lair.

quests.name: Libram of Rapidity
quests.objective: Bring a Libram of Rapidity, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Blood of Heroes to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Rapidity.
quests.note: Repeatable. Needs your faction's Elven Legends turned in first.

quests.name: Libram of Focus

entrance.label: Scholomance Entrance

quests.name: Kirtonos the Herald
quests.turnin: Eva Sarkhoff, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
quests.objective: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul. Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.
quests.pickup: Eva Sarkhoff, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
quests.note: Use the Blood of Innocents at the brazier on the Scholomance porch. Rewards the Spectral Essence.

quests.name: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors
quests.turnin: Eva Sarkhoff, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
quests.objective: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.
quests.pickup: Eva Sarkhoff, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
quests.note: The bag drops from Jandice Barov.

quests.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
quests.turnin: Eva Sarkhoff, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
quests.objective: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.
quests.pickup: Eva Sarkhoff, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands

quests.name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
quests.turnin: Magistrate Marduke, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
quests.objective: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.
quests.pickup: Magistrate Marduke, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
quests.note: Use the Soulbound Keepsake on Ras Frostwhisper to make him human, then kill him and bring back his human head.

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
quests.turnin: Weldon Barov, Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands
quests.objective: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.
quests.pickup: Weldon Barov, Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands
quests.note: The four deeds: Southshore in the first large chamber, Tarren Mill before the hatchlings, Brill by Ras Frostwhisper, Caer Darrow by Lord Alexei Barov. The follow-up The Last Barov sends you to kill the rival brother.

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
quests.turnin: Alexi Barov, The Bulwark, Tirisfal Glades
quests.objective: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.
quests.pickup: Alexi Barov, The Bulwark, Tirisfal Glades
quests.note: The four deeds: Southshore in the first large chamber, Tarren Mill before the hatchlings, Brill by Ras Frostwhisper, Caer Darrow by Lord Alexei Barov. The follow-up The Last Barov sends you to kill the rival brother.

quests.pickup: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
quests.note: Use Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room and defeat Vectus.

quests.name: Plagued Hatchlings

quests.pickup: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
quests.note: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings. After turning this in, hatchlings can drop Healthy Dragon Scales, which start a repeatable turn-in to Betina.

quests.name: Imp Delivery

quests.objective: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance. After the parchment is created, return the jar to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.
quests.pickup: Gorzeeki Wildeyes, Altar of Storms, Burning Steppes
quests.note: Warlock dreadsteed quest. Release the Imp in a Jar at the alchemy lab in Ras Frostwhisper's room and wait for the parchment.

quests.name: Judgment and Redemption
quests.objective: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver. Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger. Give the Charger's Redeemed Soul and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.
quests.pickup: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker, Cathedral of Light, Stormwind
quests.note: Paladin charger quest. Clear Rattlegore's basement in the Great Ossuary, use the Divination Scryer and defeat the spirits and Death Knight Darkreaver.

quests.name: The Darkreaver Menace
quests.turnin: Sagorne Creststrider, Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar
quests.objective: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth spirits you must fight. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver; defeat him. Bring Darkreaver's Head to Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar.
quests.pickup: Sagorne Creststrider, Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar
quests.note: Shaman quest. Clear Rattlegore's basement, use the scryer and defeat Death Knight Darkreaver; return his head.

quests.name: The Darkreaver Menace

quests.note: Shaman quest. Clear Rattlegore's basement, use the scryer and defeat Death Knight Darkreaver; return his head.

Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated. Enter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum. Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.

Small Sack of Gems
6,200 XP

startItem: Reported random spawn inside Ruins of Lordaeron; check towers, side rooms and the Bjork area

5,450 XP

quests.rewards:

Tarnished Locket

Ruins of Lordaeron.description: Scourge forces still haunt the ruined capital while a necromancer gathers power within the city.

map.label: Nave per Auberdine, Porto di Roccavento
map.detail: La nave per Auberdine parte dal molo più a sud, Molo 1, del Porto di Roccavento.

steps.text: Vai al Porto di Roccavento e prendi la nave per Auberdine. Una volta arrivato, vai sul lato opposto dei moli di Auberdine e sali sulla nave diretta al Porto di Menethil. Non scendere a Menethil, resta sulla stessa nave, proseguirà fino a Southshore nelle Alture di Colletorto.
steps.title: Vai al Porto di Roccavento

steps.text: Lascia Southshore e segui la strada verso i Campi di Hillsbrad. Da lì, continua verso nord in direzione di Dalaran.
steps.title: Segui la strada da Southshore
Passa attorno a Dalaran
steps.text: Continua verso nord e passa attorno a Dalaran finché non raggiungi il Lago Lordamere. Non è necessario entrare a Dalaran.

steps.title: Nuota verso nord nel Lago Lordamere
steps.text: Nuota verso nord attraverso il Lago Lordamere, passando dalla zona di Selva Pinargento alle Radure di Tirisfal.

steps.title: Segui la strada verso Sepulcra
steps.text: Quando raggiungi le Radure di Tirisfal, segui la strada verso Sepulcra. Una volta entrato a Sepulcra, gira a sinistra e sali le scale, lì si trova l'ingresso della spedizione.

itIT.title: Percorso dell'Alleanza verso le Rovine di Lordaeron
itIT.subtitle: Percorso Alleanza

map.label: 前往奥伯丁的船，暴风城港口
map.detail: 前往奥伯丁的船从暴风城港口最南端的1号码头出发。

steps.text: 在暴风城港口乘船前往奥伯丁。抵达后，前往奥伯丁码头的另一侧，登上前往米奈希尔港的船。不要在米奈希尔港下船，留在同一艘船上，它会继续驶往希尔斯布莱德丘陵的南海镇。
steps.title: 前往暴风城港口

steps.text: 离开南海镇，沿着道路前往希尔斯布莱德农场。从那里继续向北前往达拉然。
steps.title: 从南海镇沿路前进
绕过达拉然
steps.text: 继续向北，绕过达拉然直到抵达洛丹米尔湖。无需进入达拉然。

steps.title: 向北游过洛丹米尔湖
steps.text: 向北游过洛丹米尔湖，从银松森林一带进入提瑞斯法林地。

steps.title: 沿路前往幽暗城
steps.text: 抵达提瑞斯法林地后，沿着道路前往幽暗城。进入幽暗城后，向左转并上楼，那里就是副本入口。

zhCN.title: 联盟前往洛丹伦废墟的路线
zhCN.subtitle: 联盟路线

map.label: Schiff nach Auberdine, Hafen von Sturmwind
map.detail: Das Schiff nach Auberdine legt am südlichsten Steg, Dock 1, im Hafen von Sturmwind ab.

steps.text: Gehe zum Hafen von Sturmwind und nimm das Schiff nach Auberdine. Dort angekommen, geh auf die gegenüberliegende Seite der Auberdine-Docks und steig auf das Schiff nach Menethil. Steig in Menethil nicht aus, bleib auf demselben Schiff, es fährt weiter nach Süderstade im Vorgebirge des Hügellands.
steps.title: Zum Hafen von Sturmwind

steps.text: Verlasse Süderstade und folge der Straße in Richtung Hügellandhöfe. Von dort aus geh weiter nach Norden in Richtung Dalaran.
steps.title: Folge der Straße von Süderstade
Um Dalaran herum
steps.text: Gehe weiter nach Norden und um Dalaran herum, bis du den Lordameresee erreichst. Du musst Dalaran nicht betreten.

steps.title: Durch den Lordameresee nach Norden schwimmen
steps.text: Schwimme nach Norden durch den Lordameresee, vom Silberwald aus bis in die Tirisfalglades.

steps.title: Folge der Straße nach Unterstadt
steps.text: Sobald du die Tirisfalglades erreichst, folge der Straße in Richtung Unterstadt. Wenn du Unterstadt betrittst, geh nach links und die Treppe hinauf, dort befindet sich der Dungeoneingang.

deDE.title: Allianz-Route zu den Ruinen von Lordaeron
deDE.subtitle: Allianz-Route

map.label: 前往奧伯丁的船，暴風城港口
map.detail: 前往奧伯丁的船從暴風城港口最南端的1號碼頭出發。

steps.text: 在暴風城港口乘船前往奧伯丁。抵達後，前往奧伯丁碼頭的另一側，登上前往米奈希爾港的船。不要在米奈希爾港下船，留在同一艘船上，它會繼續駛往希爾斯布萊德丘陵的南海鎮。
steps.title: 前往暴風城港口

steps.text: 離開南海鎮，沿著道路前往希爾斯布萊德農場。從那裡繼續向北前往達拉然。
steps.title: 從南海鎮沿路前進
繞過達拉然
steps.text: 繼續向北，繞過達拉然直到抵達洛丹米爾湖。無需進入達拉然。

steps.title: 向北遊過洛丹米爾湖
steps.text: 向北遊過洛丹米爾湖，從銀松森林一帶進入提里斯法林地。

steps.title: 沿路前往幽暗城
steps.text: 抵達提里斯法林地後，沿著道路前往幽暗城。進入幽暗城後，向左轉並上樓，那裡就是副本入口。

zhTW.title: 聯盟前往洛丹倫廢墟的路線
zhTW.subtitle: 聯盟路線

map.label: Bateau pour Auberdine, port de Hurlevent
map.detail: Le bateau pour Auberdine part du quai le plus au sud, quai 1, au port de Hurlevent.

steps.text: Allez au port de Hurlevent et prenez le bateau pour Auberdine. À votre arrivée, rendez-vous de l'autre côté des quais d'Auberdine et montez à bord du navire pour le port de Menethil. Ne descendez pas à Menethil, restez sur le même navire, il continuera jusqu'à Southshore dans les contreforts de Hautebrande.
steps.title: Allez au port de Hurlevent

steps.text: Quittez Southshore et suivez la route vers les champs de Hautebrande. De là, continuez vers le nord en direction de Dalaran.
steps.title: Suivez la route depuis Southshore
Contournez Dalaran
steps.text: Continuez vers le nord et contournez Dalaran jusqu'au lac Lordamere. Il n'est pas nécessaire d'entrer dans Dalaran.

steps.title: Nagez vers le nord dans le lac Lordamere
steps.text: Traversez le lac Lordamere vers le nord, depuis la région de la forêt des Pins argentés jusqu'aux Clairières de Tirisfal.

steps.title: Suivez la route vers Fossoyeuse
steps.text: Une fois dans les Clairières de Tirisfal, suivez la route vers Fossoyeuse. En entrant dans Fossoyeuse, tournez à gauche et montez les escaliers, l'entrée du donjon se trouve là.

frFR.title: Itinéraire Alliance vers les Ruines de Lordaeron
frFR.subtitle: Itinéraire Alliance

map.label: Navio para Auberdine, Porto de Ventobravo
map.detail: O navio para Auberdine parte do cais mais ao sul, Cais 1, no Porto de Ventobravo.

steps.text: Vá ao Porto de Ventobravo e pegue o navio para Auberdine. Ao chegar, vá para o lado oposto das docas de Auberdine e embarque no navio para o Porto de Menethil. Não desça em Menethil, permaneça no mesmo navio, ele seguirá até Costa Sul, no Contraforte de Eira dos Montes.
steps.title: Vá ao Porto de Ventobravo

steps.text: Saia de Costa Sul e siga a estrada em direção aos Campos de Eira dos Montes. De lá, continue para o norte em direção a Dalaran.
steps.title: Siga a estrada saindo de Costa Sul
Contorne Dalaran
steps.text: Continue para o norte e contorne Dalaran até chegar ao Lago Lordamere. Não é necessário entrar em Dalaran.

steps.title: Nade para o norte pelo Lago Lordamere
steps.text: Nade para o norte pelo Lago Lordamere, passando da região da Floresta de Pinhaprata até as Clareiras de Tirisfal.

steps.title: Siga a estrada até a Cidade Baixa
steps.text: Ao chegar às Clareiras de Tirisfal, siga a estrada em direção à Cidade Baixa. Ao entrar na Cidade Baixa, vire à esquerda e suba as escadas, a entrada da masmorra fica ali.

ptBR.title: Rota da Aliança até as Ruínas de Lordaeron
ptBR.subtitle: Rota da Aliança

map.label: Auberdine Ship, Stormwind Harbor
map.detail: The Auberdine ship leaves from the southernmost dock, Dock 1, in Stormwind Harbor.

steps.text: Head to Stormwind Harbor and take the boat to Auberdine. Once you arrive, go to the opposite side of the Auberdine docks and board the ship to Menethil Harbor. Do not get off at Menethil Harbor, stay on the same ship and it will continue to Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.
steps.title: Go to Stormwind Harbor

steps.text: Leave Southshore and follow the road toward Hillsbrad Fields. From there, continue north toward Dalaran.
steps.title: Follow the road from Southshore
Pass around Dalaran
steps.text: Continue north and go around Dalaran until you reach Lordamere Lake. You do not need to enter Dalaran.

steps.title: Swim north through Lordamere Lake
steps.text: Swim north across Lordamere Lake, passing from the Silverpine area into Tirisfal Glades.

steps.title: Follow the road to Undercity
steps.text: Once you reach Tirisfal Glades, follow the road toward Undercity. Once you enter Undercity, turn left and go upstairs, there's the dungeon entrance.

enUS.title: Alliance Route to Ruins of Lordaeron
enUS.subtitle: Alliance route

map.label: Barco a Auberdine, Puerto de Ventormenta
map.detail: El barco a Auberdine sale del muelle más al sur, muelle 1, del Puerto de Ventormenta.

steps.text: Ve al Puerto de Ventormenta y toma el barco a Auberdine. Al llegar, ve al lado opuesto de los muelles de Auberdine y sube al barco hacia el Puerto de Menethil. No bajes en Menethil, quédate en el mismo barco, continuará hasta Costasur en las Laderas de Trabalomas.
steps.title: Ve al Puerto de Ventormenta

steps.text: Sal de Costasur y sigue el camino hacia los Campos de Trabalomas. Desde allí, continúa hacia el norte en dirección a Dalaran.
steps.title: Sigue el camino desde Costasur
Rodea Dalaran
steps.text: Continúa hacia el norte y rodea Dalaran hasta llegar al Lago Lordamere. No necesitas entrar en Dalaran.

steps.title: Nada al norte por el Lago Lordamere
steps.text: Nada hacia el norte por el Lago Lordamere, pasando desde la zona del Bosque de Argénteos hasta los Claros de Tirisfal.

steps.title: Sigue el camino hacia Entrañas
steps.text: Cuando llegues a los Claros de Tirisfal, sigue el camino hacia Entrañas. Cuando entres en Entrañas, gira a la izquierda y sube las escaleras, allí está la entrada de la mazmorra.

esES.title: Ruta de la Alianza a las Ruinas de Lordaeron
esES.subtitle: Ruta de la Alianza

map.label: 아우버다인행 배, 스톰윈드 항구
map.detail: 아우버다인행 배는 스톰윈드 항구의 가장 남쪽 부두인 1번 부두에서 출발합니다.

steps.text: 스톰윈드 항구에서 아우버다인행 배를 타세요. 도착하면 아우버다인 부두 반대편으로 가서 메네실 항구행 배에 탑승하세요. 메네실 항구에서 내리지 말고 그대로 타고 있으면 힐스브래드 구릉지의 사우스쇼어까지 계속 갑니다.
steps.title: 스톰윈드 항구로 이동

steps.text: 사우스쇼어를 떠나 힐스브래드 농장 방향으로 길을 따라가세요. 그곳에서 북쪽으로 달라란을 향해 계속 이동하세요.
steps.title: 사우스쇼어에서 길 따라가기
달라란 우회하기
steps.text: 북쪽으로 계속 가서 로데미어 호수에 도착할 때까지 달라란을 돌아가세요. 달라란에 들어갈 필요는 없습니다.

steps.title: 로데미어 호수를 헤엄쳐 북쪽으로
steps.text: 로데미어 호수를 가로질러 북쪽으로 헤엄치면 은빛소나무 숲 지역에서 티리스팔 숲으로 넘어갑니다.

steps.title: 언더시티로 가는 길 따라가기
steps.text: 티리스팔 숲에 도착하면 언더시티 방향으로 길을 따라가세요. 언더시티에 들어서면 왼쪽으로 돌아 계단을 올라가면 던전 입구가 있습니다.

map.label: Корабль в Аубердин, гавань Штормграда
map.detail: Корабль в Аубердин отправляется от самого южного причала, причал 1, в гавани Штормграда.

steps.text: Отправляйтесь в гавань Штормграда и сядьте на корабль до Аубердина. Прибыв в Аубердин, перейдите на противоположную сторону пристани и сядьте на корабль до гавани Менетилов. В Менетиле не выходите, оставайтесь на том же корабле, он продолжит путь до Южнобережья в Предгорьях Хилсбрада.
steps.title: Отправляйтесь в гавань Штормграда

steps.text: Покиньте Южнобережье и следуйте по дороге к Хилсбрадским полям. Оттуда продолжайте двигаться на север в сторону Даларана.
steps.title: Следуйте по дороге из Южнобережья
Обойдите Даларан
steps.text: Продолжайте двигаться на север и обойдите Даларан, пока не достигнете озера Лордамер. Заходить в Даларан не нужно.

steps.title: Плывите на север через озеро Лордамер
steps.text: Плывите на север через озеро Лордамер, из Серебряного бора в Тирисфальские леса.

steps.title: Следуйте по дороге в Подгород
steps.text: Добравшись до Тирисфальских лесов, следуйте по дороге к Подгороду. Войдя в Подгород, поверните налево и поднимитесь по лестнице, там находится вход в подземелье.

quests.name: This Must Be The Place
quests.turnin: Hastily Rolled-Up Satchel, right under the Messenger Bag
quests.objective: Search the Hastily Rolled-Up Satchel under the Messenger Bag at Thoradin's Wall.
quests.pickup: Messenger Bag hanging at Thoradin's Wall, Hillsbrad Foothills (85.7, 52.2)

startMap.label: Messenger Bag — Thoradin's Wall
startMap.detail: Hanging outside the room in Thoradin's Wall

turninMap.label: Hastily Rolled-Up Satchel — Thoradin's Wall
turninMap.detail: Right under the Messenger Bag

quests.pickup: Qiaga the Keeper, top of the Altar of Zul, The Hinterlands (48.6, 68.0)
quests.name: Mallet of Zul'Farrak
quests.turnin: The gong at Gahz'rilla's pool, inside Zul'Farrak: use the Mallet of Zul'Farrak there to summon Gahz'rilla.
quests.objective: Kill Qiaga the Keeper to loot the Sacred Mallet.

objectiveMore.text: Then use the Sacred Mallet at the altar on the very top of %s: it turns into the Mallet of Zul'Farrak.

map.label: Altar of Jintha'Alor — The Hinterlands
map.detail: The altar at the very top of Jintha'Alor

objectiveMap.label: Qiaga the Keeper — Altar of Zul, The Hinterlands
objectiveMap.detail: At the top of the Altar of Zul

quests.note: Qiaga the Keeper and Morta'gya the Keeper are level 50 elites with casters around them, and the way up to the top altar is full of level 45-50 trolls: bring a group, or sneak up. Everyone in the group can loot a Sacred Mallet, and it can be used in combat. One Mallet of Zul'Farrak in the group is enough, and it summons Gahz'rilla in every later run too.
quests.warning: There is no quest to pick up here. Just kill and loot.

entrance.label: City of Dalaran Entrance
entrance.detail: Enter through the city's sewers: drop through a grate in the streets and follow the Underbelly pipe to the portal

bosses.name: Atrexis the Grave Knight
bosses.description: At the ritual circle in the Underbelly, surrounded by Kirin Tor Necromancers and rising skeletons. Disarms.

bosses.name: Arcane Anomaly
bosses.description: On a round terrace in the streets after leaving the sewers. Casts Arcane Bolt and Focal Blast.

bosses.name: Fel Ancient
bosses.description: A fel-touched treant in the streets, among Suffused Treants.

bosses.name: Unstable Sentinel
bosses.description: An arcane golem by the Magus Commerce Exchange, with Angry Tomes. Malfunction hits everyone within 25 yards.

bosses.name: Lyn the Ignored
bosses.description: Rare elite.

bosses.name: Shade of the Archmage
bosses.description: Final boss, in the Purple Parlor of the Violet Citadel. Don't stand in line with the Bounding Mana target; he polymorphs the group and resets if someone leaves the room.

bosses.name: Trash Drops
loot: Dark Caster / Saturated Remnant / Mindless Horror
Saturated Remnant / Fallen Mage / Seeking Remnant
Mana Stalker / Dark Caster / Arcane Echo
Mana Echo / Dark Caster / Kirin Tor Necromancer

quests.name: A Green Sample
quests.objective: Retrieve a Fel Infused Blossom from Dalaran's central garden.

quests.name: Power Overwhelming
quests.objective: Slay Arcanic Enigma, the Mana Elemental in the City of Dalaran, and return to High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind City.

quests.name: Starving Arcane
quests.turnin: Image of Archmage Modera, Lordamere Lake near Dalaran
quests.objective: Defeat 8 Seeking Remnants, 8 Saturated Remnants, and 8 Mana Echoes inside the City of Dalaran for Archmage Modera outside of Dalaran.

startMap.label: Image of Archmage Modera — Lordamere Lake near Dalaran

quests.pickup: Image of Archmage Modera, Lordamere Lake near Dalaran
quests.note: There may not be enough of these mobs inside to finish it in one run.

quests.name: Heart of Disruption
quests.turnin: Image of Archmage Modera, Lordamere Lake near Dalaran
quests.objective: Collect the Arcane Mote for the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.
quests.pickup: Image of Archmage Modera, Lordamere Lake near Dalaran

startMap.label: Image of Archmage Modera — Lordamere Lake

providedItem: Provided when Heart of Disruption is accepted

quests.pickup: Image of Archmage Modera, Lordamere Lake near Dalaran

quests.name: Heart of Disruption
quests.turnin: Magus Wordeen Voidglare, Tarren Mill, Hillsbrad Foothills
quests.objective: Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
providedItem: Provided when Heart of Disruption is accepted
quests.note: Horde Dalaran attunement. Stone Tokens and Bracers of Binding can be done alongside the chain, but they are optional and are not required for attunement.

quests.name: Opportunistic Education
quests.turnin: Rexxie Copperclutch, inside the dungeon, near the sewer entrance
quests.objective: Recover The Founding of Dalaran and deliver it to Rexxie Copperclutch.
quests.pickup: Rexxie Copperclutch, inside the dungeon, near the sewer entrance
quests.note: This quest is done at the library, in the Alliance portal area of Wrath of the Lich King's Dalaran.

quests.name: Source of Power
quests.objective: Collect 6 Cracked Sentry Cores from the constructs in Dalaran.

quests.name: The Grave Knight
quests.objective: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the Dalaran Underbelly.

City of Dalaran.description: The restored mage city of Dalaran has become a new five-player dungeon in WoW Forever. Enter through the sewers and the Underbelly, then fight through the streets to the Violet Citadel.

bosses.name: Spirestone Butcher
bosses.description: Rare ogre in the Spirestone area before Highlord Omokk.

bosses.name: Spirestone Battle Lord
bosses.description: Rare ogre near Highlord Omokk.

bosses.name: Spirestone Lord Magus
bosses.description: Rare ogre caster near Highlord Omokk.

bosses.name: Highlord Omokk
bosses.description: Spirestone ogre chief on the ledge in Hordemar City. Drops the Gemstone of Spirestone.

bosses.name: Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin
bosses.description: Smolderthorn troll shadow hunter on the way to Voone.

bosses.name: War Master Voone
bosses.description: Smolderthorn troll leader in Mok'Doom. Drops the Gemstone of Smolderthorn.

bosses.name: Mor Grayhoof
bosses.description: Summoned in War Master Voone's room with the Brazier from the Dungeon Set 2 quests: one of the four bosses that drop a piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet.

bosses.name: Mother Smolderweb
loot: Formula: Dormant Heart of the Mountain
bosses.description: Spider queen in the Skitterweb Tunnels. Get poisoned for Mother's Milk.

bosses.name: Crystal Fang
bosses.description: Rare spider in the Skitterweb Tunnels.

bosses.name: Urok Doomhowl
bosses.description: Summoned at his pike with Warosh's quest items, along with waves of ogres.

bosses.name: Bannok Grimaxe
bosses.description: Rare Firebrand champion near the Storehouse.

bosses.name: Burning Felguard
bosses.description: Rare demon: Scarshield Warlocks can summon it through their portals.

bosses.name: Quartermaster Zigris
bosses.description: In the Storehouse, guarded by Bloodaxe ogres.

bosses.name: Halycon
bosses.description: Bloodaxe worg pack mistress in her den. Gizrul comes out after she dies.

bosses.name: Gizrul the Slavener
bosses.description: Comes for you shortly after Halycon dies.

bosses.name: Ghok Bashguud
bosses.description: Rare Bloodaxe champion on the bridge to Wyrmthalak.

bosses.name: Overlord Wyrmthalak
bosses.description: Final boss: Bloodaxe overlord in the Chamber of Battle; calls two Bloodaxe Veterans at low health. Drops the Gemstone of Bloodaxe.

entrance.label: Lower Blackrock Spire Entrance
entrance.detail: Blackrock Mountain, between Searing Gorge and the Burning Steppes: climb to the upper ledge to the Blackrock Spire portal

quests.name: Seal of Ascension
quests.objective: Find the three gemstones of command: the Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan. The generals are War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn, Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.
requiredItems: Dropped by Highlord Omokk, Lower Blackrock Spire
Dropped by War Master Voone, Lower Blackrock Spire
Dropped by Overlord Wyrmthalak, Lower Blackrock Spire
Random drop from Blackrock Spire trash

quests.name: Bijou's Belongings
quests.objective: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. Good luck!
quests.note: Bijou hides in a recess beyond the early bridges. Her belongings spawn in one of several places around the troll and orc rooms.

quests.name: Operative Bijou
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.

quests.name: Bijou's Belongings
quests.objective: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.
quests.note: Then take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report to Lexlort in Kargath for the reward.

quests.name: Maxwell's Mission
quests.turnin: Marshal Maxwell, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.
quests.pickup: Marshal Maxwell, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes

quests.name: Warlord's Command
quests.objective: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
quests.note: Talk to Goretooth to receive his Command item and click it to start the quest. The Important Blackrock Documents spawn near the three generals.

quests.name: Put Her Down
quests.turnin: Helendis Riverhorn, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy the source of the worg menace. As you left Helendis, he shouted a name: Halycon. It is what the orcs refer to in regards to the worg.
quests.pickup: Helendis Riverhorn, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.note: Kill Halycon, the worg den mother. Be ready for Gizrul the Slavener, who comes for you right after.

quests.name: The Pack Mistress
quests.objective: Slay Halycon, pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg.
quests.note: Kill Halycon, the worg den mother. Be ready for Gizrul the Slavener, who comes for you right after.

quests.name: Kibler's Exotic Pets
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.
quests.note: Use the supplied cage on a Bloodaxe Worg Pup in the worg area.

quests.name: En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why
quests.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler. By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.
quests.note: Spire Spider Eggs are in the spider tunnels.

quests.name: Mother's Milk
quests.turnin: Ragged John, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes
quests.objective: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Return to Ragged John while poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.
quests.pickup: Ragged John, Flame Crest, Burning Steppes
quests.note: Get poisoned by Mother Smolderweb and reach Ragged John while still poisoned. Don't let anyone cleanse it.

quests.name: Urok Doomhowl
quests.objective: Read Warosh's Scroll. Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.
quests.note: Bring Highlord Omokk's Head and a Roughshod Pike to Urok's Tribute Pile beyond the spiders to start the waves.

quests.name: General Drakkisath's Command
quests.turnin: Marshal Maxwell, Morgan's Vigil, Burning Steppes
quests.objective: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.
quests.pickup: General Drakkisath's Command (drops from Overlord Wyrmthalak)
quests.note: Leads to General Drakkisath's Demise in Upper Blackrock Spire.
startItem: Dropped by Overlord Wyrmthalak in Lower Blackrock Spire

quests.name: The Final Tablets
quests.objective: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.
quests.note: The fifth and sixth Mosh'aru tablets are in the Smolderthorn troll area. Continues with Confront Yeh'kinya and The Hand of Rastakhan.

Lower Blackrock Spire.description: The lower halls of Blackrock Spire, held by the Spirestone, Smolderthorn and Bloodaxe clans of the Dark Horde under Overlord Wyrmthalak.

entrance.label: Excavation Site: Wetlands Entrance
entrance.detail: Blue mist portal under a large tree, in the hills southeast of Whelgar's Excavation, reached from Thelgen Rock

bosses.name: Saltspine
bosses.description: A white crocolisk.

bosses.name: Shadetooth
bosses.description: A giant violet raptor, leader of the Thicket raptors.

bosses.name: Relic Guardian
bosses.description: Final boss: a stone Titan construct.

quests.name: Open the Maw
quests.objective: Defeat 2 Dragonmaw Saboteurs and 4 Dragonmaw Warders, recover the Dragonmaw Dispatch, and report to the Deathstalker Agent outside the dungeon.
quests.turnin: Deathstalker Agent, just outside Excavation Site: Wetlands
quests.pickup: Deathstalker Agent, just outside Excavation Site: Wetlands
quests.note: Related lead-in: Dragonmaw Rumors. The Dragonmaw Dispatch is recovered from the Dragonmaw forces inside the dungeon.

quests.name: Changing Tastes
quests.objective: Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back 4 Thicket Raptor Meat.
quests.note: Thicket Raptor Meat comes from the Thicket raptors (Thicket Lurker, Thicket Hunter, Thicket Matriarch) in Stalker's Thicket, the area of Shadetooth.

quests.name: Highland Hides
quests.objective: Collect 4 Thicket Raptor Hides and take them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.

quests.name: Songblade Search
quests.objective: Look for Dorin Songblade's brother, Daewyn, in Whelgar's Excavation Site.
quests.turnin: Daewyn Songblade, inside Excavation Site: Wetlands

quests.name: Horrors in the Highland
quests.objective: Kill a Highland Horror within Excavation Sites and bring its root core to Rethiel the Greenwarden in the Wetlands.

quests.name: Lost in the Thicket Things
quests.turnin: Ardin Grassman, inside Excavation Site: Wetlands
quests.objective: Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites. Learn what happened to Ardin Grassman.

startMap.detail: Start Lost in the Thicket Things here

quests.name: Heartwoven
quests.objective: Take the Reed-woven Heart back to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
quests.pickup: Ardin Grassman, inside Excavation Site: Wetlands

quests.name: Prehistoric Prism
quests.turnin: High Explorer Magellas, Hall of Explorers, Ironforge
quests.objective: Deliver the Titan Relic to High Explorer Magellas in the Hall of Explorers.
quests.pickup: Prospector Whelgar, Whelgar's Excavation Site, Wetlands

quests.name: Earthen Echo
quests.objective: Deliver the Titan Relic to Muln Earthfury on Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
quests.pickup: Bashana Runetotem, Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff

startMap.label: Bashana Runetotem — Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff

quests.name: Fallen in the Fen
quests.objective: Report Daewyn's fate to Dorin Songblade in Lakeshire.
quests.pickup: Daewyn Songblade, inside Excavation Site: Wetlands

Excavation Site: Wetlands.description: A Titan dig site trapped in time above Whelgar's Excavation, where errant Titan constructs have stopped obeying anyone. Areas inside: Lost Marsh, Stalker's Thicket, Site of the Guardian and Lost Dig Site.

entrance.label: Ragefire Chasm Entrance
entrance.detail: Dungeon entrance in the Cleft of Shadow

quests.name: Testing an Enemy's Strength
quests.objective: Kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shamans inside Ragefire Chasm.

quests.name: Searching for the Lost Satchel
quests.turnin: Maur Grimtotem's corpse, inside Ragefire Chasm
quests.objective: Find Maur Grimtotem's corpse inside Ragefire Chasm and search it for anything of interest.
quests.note: From the first major three-way junction, take the right-hand tunnel, follow it uphill toward the dead end, then enter the small side room on the left. Interact with Maur's corpse there.

quests.name: Returning the Lost Satchel
quests.objective: Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
quests.pickup: Grimtotem Satchel, taken from Maur Grimtotem's corpse inside Ragefire Chasm

quests.name: Hidden Enemies
quests.objective: Kill Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker inside Ragefire Chasm.
quests.note: Requires the earlier Hidden Enemies chain steps in Orgrimmar. The next Hidden Enemies step later offers:

quests.name: Slaying the Beast
quests.objective: Slay Taragaman the Hungerer and recover Taragaman the Hungerer's Heart.
quests.pickup: Neeru Fireblade, Cleft of Shadow, Orgrimmar
quests.turnin: Neeru Fireblade, Cleft of Shadow, Orgrimmar

quests.name: The Power to Destroy...
quests.objective: Collect Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether inside Ragefire Chasm.

Ragefire Chasm.description: Troggs and Burning Blade cultists infest the molten caverns beneath Orgrimmar.

Choose: Catacomb Cloak or Deepgrave Trousers
2,300 XP

Hall of Thanes.description: Someone has broken into the royal dwarven burial chamber beneath Ironforge.

steps.title: Se non sei un Non Morto, prendi lo zeppelin da Orgrimmar a Sepulcra

map.label: Zeppelin per Sepulcra
map.detail: Lo zeppelin per Sepulcra attracca alla torre fuori da Orgrimmar. Chiedi a Frezza se non sei sicuro di quale sia.

steps.title: Sepulcra -> Selva Pinargento -> Mulino di Tarren
steps.text: Viaggia verso sud da Sepulcra attraverso le Radure di Tirisfal e la Selva Pinargento, poi continua nelle Alture di Colletorto fino a raggiungere il Mulino di Tarren.

steps.title: Mulino di Tarren -> Altopiani d'Arathi
steps.text: Segui la strada verso est fino agli Altopiani d'Arathi, poi prosegui verso sud in direzione del grande ponte di pietra.

steps.title: Ponte di Thandol (Altopiani d'Arathi / Paludi Grigie)
steps.text: Questo enorme ponte attraversa la gola verso le Paludi Grigie ed è il tuo ingresso nel territorio dell'Alleanza.

steps.title: Paludi Grigie
steps.text: Rimani sulla strada principale e prosegui verso sud-est. È il percorso più sicuro, quindi seguilo fino in fondo.

steps.title: Dun Algaz (Paludi Grigie / Loch Modan)
steps.text: Questo passo di montagna conduce a Loch Modan. Al checkpoint ci sono guardie dell'Alleanza, quindi continua a correre e attraversalo senza fermarti.

steps.title: Loch Modan -> Dun Morogh
steps.text: Dirigiti a ovest verso il tunnel che collega Loch Modan a Dun Morogh. Attraversa il cancello e continua a ovest verso Forgiardente.

steps.title: Prima di entrare a Forgiardente (Dun Morogh)
steps.text: Togliti l'equipaggiamento. Le guardie probabilmente ti uccideranno alcune volte e l'equipaggiamento non indossato non perde durabilità.

steps.title: Forgiardente
steps.text: Raggiungi l'Alto Seggio, la sala del trono di Re Magni. Entrando, prendi il corridoio coperto di ragnatele sulla sinistra, alle coordinate 43.5, 52.0.

steps.title: Corsa dal cadavere
steps.text: Il Guaritore Spirituale si trova subito fuori dalla città, quindi dopo ogni morte il tragitto di ritorno è breve. Resuscita negli angoli tranquilli fuori dalla visuale delle guardie per avanzare un po' ogni volta.

steps.title: Vecchia Forgiardente
steps.text: Segui le scale tortuose e i sentieri di pietra verso il basso. Il percorso termina su un ponte sopra la lava, dove si trovano il PNG della missione Thom Filch e il portale del dungeon.

itIT.title: Percorso dell'Orda verso la Sala dei Thane
itIT.subtitle: Percorso Orda

steps.title: 如果你不是亡灵，请从奥格瑞玛乘坐飞艇前往幽暗城

map.label: 前往幽暗城的飞艇
map.detail: 前往幽暗城的飞艇停靠在奥格瑞玛外的飞艇塔。如果不确定是哪一艘，可以询问弗雷扎。

steps.title: 幽暗城 -> 银松森林 -> 塔伦米尔
steps.text: 从幽暗城出发向南穿过提瑞斯法林地和银松森林，然后进入希尔斯布莱德丘陵，直到抵达塔伦米尔。

steps.title: 塔伦米尔 -> 阿拉希高地
steps.text: 沿着道路向东进入阿拉希高地，然后沿路向南前往那座巨大的石桥。

steps.title: 萨多尔大桥（阿拉希高地 / 湿地交界）
steps.text: 这座巨大的桥横跨峡谷通往湿地，是你进入联盟领土的门户。

steps.title: 湿地
steps.text: 沿着向东南方向的主路前进。道路是最安全的路线，请一路沿路走。

steps.title: 丹奥加兹（湿地 / 洛克莫丹交界）
steps.text: 这条山口通往洛克莫丹。检查站有联盟守卫，不要停下，靠速度冲过去。

steps.title: 洛克莫丹 -> 丹莫罗
steps.text: 向西前往连接洛克莫丹和丹莫罗的隧道。穿过大门后继续向西前往铁炉堡。

steps.title: 进入铁炉堡之前（丹莫罗）
steps.text: 脱下你的装备。你很可能会被守卫杀死几次，而未装备的物品不会损失耐久度。

steps.title: 铁炉堡
steps.text: 前往国王麦格尼的王座厅——大王座。进入时走左边被蜘蛛网覆盖的走廊，坐标 43.5, 52.0。

steps.title: 跑尸
steps.text: 灵魂医者就在城外，所以每次死亡只需跑一小段路。在守卫看不到的僻静角落复活，这样每次都能向前推进。

steps.title: 旧铁炉堡
steps.text: 沿着蜿蜒的楼梯和石路向下走。道路尽头是熔岩上的一座桥，任务发布者汤姆·菲尔奇和副本传送门就在那里。

zhCN.title: 部落前往领主之厅的路线
zhCN.subtitle: 部落路线

steps.title: Wenn du kein Untoter bist, nimm den Zeppelin von Orgrimmar nach Unterstadt

map.label: Zeppelin nach Unterstadt
map.detail: Der Zeppelin nach Unterstadt legt am Turm vor Orgrimmar an. Frag Frezza, wenn du dir nicht sicher bist, welcher es ist.

steps.title: Unterstadt -> Silberwald -> Tarrens Mühle
steps.text: Reise von Unterstadt nach Süden durch die Tirisfal und den Silberwald und weiter ins Vorgebirge des Hügellands, bis du Tarrens Mühle erreichst.

steps.title: Tarrens Mühle -> Arathihochland
steps.text: Reite auf der Straße nach Osten ins Arathihochland und folge ihr dann nach Süden bis zur großen Steinbrücke.

steps.title: Thandol-Übergang (Arathihochland / Sumpfland)
steps.text: Diese riesige Brücke führt über die Schlucht ins Sumpfland und ist dein Zugang in Allianzgebiet.

steps.title: Sumpfland
steps.text: Bleib auf der Hauptstraße und folge ihr nach Südosten. Die Straße ist der sicherste Weg, also bleib ihr die ganze Strecke treu.

steps.title: Dun Algaz (Sumpfland / Loch Modan)
steps.text: Dieser Gebirgspass führt nach Loch Modan. Am Kontrollpunkt stehen Allianz-Wachen, also lauf einfach weiter und versuche, ohne anzuhalten durchzukommen.

steps.title: Loch Modan -> Dun Morogh
steps.text: Reite nach Westen zum Tunnel, der Loch Modan mit Dun Morogh verbindet. Lauf durch das Tor und weiter nach Westen in Richtung Eisenschmiede.

steps.title: Vor dem Betreten von Eisenschmiede (Dun Morogh)
steps.text: Zieh deine Ausrüstung aus. Die Wachen werden dich wahrscheinlich ein paar Mal töten, und nicht angelegte Ausrüstung verliert keine Haltbarkeit.

steps.title: Eisenschmiede
steps.text: Geh zum Hohen Sitz, König Magnis Thronsaal. Wenn du hineingehst, nimm links den mit Spinnweben bedeckten Korridor bei den Koordinaten 43.5, 52.0.

steps.title: Leichenlauf
steps.text: Der Geistheiler steht direkt außerhalb der Stadt, daher ist der Rückweg nach jedem Tod kurz. Belebe dich in ruhigen Ecken außerhalb der Sicht der Wachen wieder, damit du jedes Mal etwas weiterkommst.

steps.title: Alt-Eisenschmiede
steps.text: Folge den gewundenen Treppen und Steinwegen nach unten. Der Weg endet an einer Brücke über Lava, bei der der Questgeber Thom Filch und das Dungeonportal stehen.

steps.title: 如果你不是亡靈，請從奧格瑪乘坐飛艇前往幽暗城

map.label: 前往幽暗城的飛艇
map.detail: 前往幽暗城的飛艇停靠在奧格瑪外的飛艇塔。如果不確定是哪一艘，可以詢問弗雷扎。

steps.title: 幽暗城 -> 銀松森林 -> 塔倫米爾
steps.text: 從幽暗城出發向南穿過提里斯法林地和銀松森林，然後進入希爾斯布萊德丘陵，直到抵達塔倫米爾。

steps.title: 塔倫米爾 -> 阿拉希高地
steps.text: 沿著道路向東進入阿拉希高地，然後沿路向南前往那座巨大的石橋。

steps.title: 薩多爾大橋（阿拉希高地 / 濕地交界）
steps.text: 這座巨大的橋橫跨峽谷通往濕地，是你進入聯盟領土的門戶。

steps.title: 濕地
steps.text: 沿著向東南方向的主路前進。道路是最安全的路線，請一路沿路走。

steps.title: 丹奧加茲（濕地 / 洛克莫丹交界）
steps.text: 這條山口通往洛克莫丹。檢查站有聯盟守衛，不要停下，靠速度衝過去。

steps.title: 洛克莫丹 -> 丹莫洛
steps.text: 向西前往連線洛克莫丹和丹莫洛的隧道。穿過大門後繼續向西前往鐵爐堡。

steps.title: 進入鐵爐堡之前（丹莫洛）
steps.text: 脫下你的裝備。你很可能會被守衛殺死幾次，而未裝備的物品不會損失耐久度。

steps.title: 鐵爐堡
steps.text: 前往國王麥格尼的王座廳——大王座。進入時走左邊被蜘蛛網覆蓋的走廊，座標 43.5, 52.0。

steps.title: 跑屍
steps.text: 靈魂醫者就在城外，所以每次死亡只需跑一小段路。在守衛看不到的僻靜角落復活，這樣每次都能向前推進。

steps.title: 舊鐵爐堡
steps.text: 沿著蜿蜒的樓梯和石路向下走。道路盡頭是熔岩上的一座橋，任務釋出者湯姆·菲爾奇和副本傳送門就在那裡。

zhTW.title: 部落前往領主之廳的路線
zhTW.subtitle: 部落路線

steps.title: Si vous n'êtes pas Mort-vivant, prenez le zeppelin d'Orgrimmar à Fossoyeuse

map.label: Zeppelin pour Fossoyeuse
map.detail: Le zeppelin pour Fossoyeuse s'amarre à la tour devant Orgrimmar. Demandez à Frezza en cas de doute.

steps.title: Fossoyeuse -> forêt des Pins argentés -> Moulin-de-Tarren
steps.text: Partez de Fossoyeuse, dirigez-vous vers le sud à travers les Clairières de Tirisfal et la forêt des Pins argentés, puis continuez jusque dans les Contreforts de Hautebrande jusqu'à atteindre Moulin-de-Tarren.

steps.title: Moulin-de-Tarren -> Hautes-terres d'Arathi
steps.text: Suivez la route vers l'est jusqu'aux Hautes-terres d'Arathi, puis continuez vers le sud en direction du grand pont de pierre.

steps.title: Pont de Thandol (Hautes-terres d'Arathi / Paluns)
steps.text: Cet immense pont traverse la gorge vers les Paluns et constitue votre passage vers le territoire de l'Alliance.

steps.title: Paluns
steps.text: Restez sur la route principale en direction du sud-est. C'est l'itinéraire le plus sûr, alors suivez-la jusqu'au bout.

steps.title: Dun Algaz (Paluns / Loch Modan)
steps.text: Ce col de montagne mène à Loch Modan. Des gardes de l'Alliance se trouvent au poste de contrôle, alors continuez à courir et traversez sans vous arrêter.

steps.title: Loch Modan -> Dun Morogh
steps.text: Dirigez-vous vers l'ouest jusqu'au tunnel qui relie Loch Modan à Dun Morogh. Passez la porte et continuez vers l'ouest en direction de Forgefer.

steps.title: Avant d'entrer dans Forgefer (Dun Morogh)
steps.text: Retirez votre équipement. Les gardes vous tueront probablement plusieurs fois, et l'équipement non porté ne perd pas de durabilité.

steps.title: Forgefer
steps.text: Allez au Haut Siège, la salle du trône du roi Magni. En entrant, prenez le couloir couvert de toiles d'araignée sur votre gauche, aux coordonnées 43.5, 52.0.

steps.title: Course en fantôme
steps.text: Le Gardien des âmes se trouve juste à l'extérieur de la ville, donc chaque mort ne demande qu'un court trajet de retour. Ressuscitez dans des coins calmes, hors de vue des gardes, afin de progresser à chaque tentative.

steps.title: Vieille Forgefer
steps.text: Suivez les escaliers sinueux et les chemins de pierre vers le bas. Le chemin se termine sur un pont au-dessus de la lave, où se trouvent le donneur de quête Thom Filch et le portail du donjon.

frFR.title: Itinéraire Horde vers la Salle des thanes
frFR.subtitle: Itinéraire Horde

steps.title: Se você não é Morto-vivo, pegue o zepelim de Orgrimmar para Cidade Baixa

map.label: Zepelim para Cidade Baixa
map.detail: O zepelim para Cidade Baixa atraca na torre fora de Orgrimmar. Pergunte a Frezza se não tiver certeza de qual é.

steps.title: Cidade Baixa -> Floresta de Pinhaprata -> Moinho Tarren
steps.text: Siga para o sul saindo da Cidade Baixa, atravesse as Clareiras de Tirisfal e a Floresta de Pinhaprata, e então continue até o Contraforte de Eira dos Montes até chegar ao Moinho Tarren.

steps.title: Moinho Tarren -> Planalto Arathi
steps.text: Siga pela estrada para leste até o Planalto Arathi e depois continue para o sul em direção à grande ponte de pedra.

steps.title: Ponte Thandol (Planalto Arathi / Pantanal)
steps.text: Essa enorme ponte atravessa o desfiladeiro até o Pantanal e é a sua entrada em território da Aliança.

steps.title: Pantanal
steps.text: Permaneça na estrada principal seguindo para sudeste. A estrada é o caminho mais seguro, então siga por ela o trajeto inteiro.

steps.title: Dun Algaz (Pantanal / Loch Modan)
steps.text: Essa passagem nas montanhas leva a Loch Modan. Há guardas da Aliança no posto de controle, então continue correndo e atravesse sem parar.

steps.title: Loch Modan -> Dun Morogh
steps.text: Siga para oeste até o túnel que liga Loch Modan a Dun Morogh. Passe pelo portão e continue para oeste em direção a Altaforja.

steps.title: Antes de entrar em Altaforja (Dun Morogh)
steps.text: Retire seu equipamento. Os guardas provavelmente vão matar você algumas vezes, e equipamentos não equipados não perdem durabilidade.

steps.title: Altaforja
steps.text: Vá até o Alto Assento, a sala do trono do Rei Magni. Ao entrar, pegue o corredor coberto de teias de aranha à esquerda, nas coordenadas 43.5, 52.0.

steps.title: Corrida de cadáver
steps.text: O Anjo da Cura fica logo do lado de fora da cidade, então cada morte exige apenas uma corrida curta de volta. Ressuscite em cantos tranquilos fora da visão dos guardas para avançar um pouco mais a cada tentativa.

steps.title: Velha Altaforja
steps.text: Siga as escadas sinuosas e os caminhos de pedra para baixo. O caminho termina em uma ponte sobre a lava, onde ficam o entregador de missão Thom Filch e o portal da masmorra.

ptBR.title: Rota da Horda até o Salão dos Thanes
ptBR.subtitle: Rota da Horda

steps.title: If you're not Undead, take the Zeppelin from Orgrimmar to Undercity

map.label: Zeppelin to Undercity
map.detail: The Undercity zeppelin docks at the tower outside Orgrimmar. Ask Frezza if you're unsure which one it is.

steps.title: Undercity -> Silverpine Forest -> Tarren Mill
steps.text: Travel south from Undercity through Tirisfal Glades and Silverpine Forest, then continue into Hillsbrad Foothills until you reach Tarren Mill.

steps.title: Tarren Mill -> Arathi Highlands
steps.text: Ride east along the road into Arathi Highlands, then follow it south toward the big stone bridge.

steps.title: Thandol Span (Arathi Highlands / Wetlands border)
steps.text: This huge bridge crosses the gorge into the Wetlands, and it is your gateway into Alliance territory.

steps.title: Wetlands
steps.text: Stay on the main road heading south-east. The road is the safest path, so stick to it all the way.

steps.title: Dun Algaz (Wetlands / Loch Modan border)
steps.text: This mountain pass leads into Loch Modan. Alliance guards stand at the checkpoint, so keep running and let your speed carry you through.

steps.title: Loch Modan -> Dun Morogh
steps.text: Head west to the tunnel that connects Loch Modan to Dun Morogh. Keep moving through the gate and continue west toward Ironforge.

steps.title: Before entering Ironforge (Dun Morogh)
steps.text: Take off your gear. Guards will likely kill you a few times, and unequipped gear takes no durability damage.

steps.title: Ironforge
steps.text: Head to the High Seat, King Magni's throne room. As you walk in, take the spiderweb-covered corridor on your left, at coordinates 43.5, 52.0.

steps.title: Corpse Running
steps.text: The Spirit Healer is right outside the city, so each death means a short run back. Resurrect in quiet corners out of the guards' sight so you gain ground every time.

steps.title: Old Ironforge
steps.text: Follow the winding stairs and stone paths downward. The path ends at a bridge over lava with the quest giver Thom Filch and the dungeon portal.

enUS.title: Horde Route to Hall of Thanes
enUS.subtitle: Horde route

steps.title: Si no eres no-muerto, toma el zepelín de Orgrimmar a Entrañas

map.label: Zepelín a Entrañas
map.detail: El zepelín a Entrañas atraca en la torre fuera de Orgrimmar. Pregunta a Frezza si no sabes cuál es.

steps.title: Entrañas -> Bosque de Argénteos -> Molino Tarren
steps.text: Viaja hacia el sur desde Entrañas a través de Claros de Tirisfal y del Bosque de Argénteos, y después continúa hasta las Laderas de Trabalomas hasta llegar a Molino Tarren.

steps.title: Molino Tarren -> Tierras Altas de Arathi
steps.text: Sigue el camino hacia el este hasta las Tierras Altas de Arathi y después continúa hacia el sur en dirección al gran puente de piedra.

steps.title: Puente Thandol (Tierras Altas de Arathi / Los Humedales)
steps.text: Este enorme puente cruza el desfiladero hasta Los Humedales y es tu entrada al territorio de la Alianza.

steps.title: Los Humedales
steps.text: Mantente en el camino principal hacia el sudeste. Es la ruta más segura, así que síguela durante todo el trayecto.

steps.title: Dun Algaz (Los Humedales / Loch Modan)
steps.text: Este paso de montaña lleva a Loch Modan. Hay guardias de la Alianza en el puesto de control, así que sigue corriendo y atraviesa la zona sin detenerte.

steps.title: Loch Modan -> Dun Morogh
steps.text: Ve hacia el oeste hasta el túnel que conecta Loch Modan con Dun Morogh. Cruza la puerta y continúa hacia el oeste en dirección a Forjaz.

steps.title: Antes de entrar en Forjaz (Dun Morogh)
steps.text: Quítate el equipo. Es probable que los guardias te maten varias veces, y el equipo que no llevas puesto no pierde durabilidad.

steps.title: Forjaz
steps.text: Ve al Alto Asiento, la sala del trono del rey Magni. Al entrar, toma el pasillo cubierto de telarañas a tu izquierda, en las coordenadas 43.5, 52.0.

steps.title: Correr desde el cadáver
steps.text: El Ángel de la Resurrección está justo fuera de la ciudad, así que cada muerte implica un trayecto corto de vuelta. Resucita en rincones tranquilos fuera de la vista de los guardias para avanzar un poco más cada vez.

steps.title: Antigua Forjaz
steps.text: Sigue las escaleras sinuosas y los caminos de piedra hacia abajo. El camino termina en un puente sobre lava, donde están el encargado de misión Thom Filch y el portal de la mazmorra.

esES.title: Ruta de la Horda a la Sala de los Thanes
esES.subtitle: Ruta de la Horda

steps.title: 언데드가 아니라면 오그리마에서 언더시티행 비행선을 타세요

map.label: 언더시티행 비행선
map.detail: 언더시티행 비행선은 오그리마 외곽의 탑에 정박합니다. 어느 비행선인지 모르겠다면 프레짜에게 물어보세요.

steps.title: 언더시티 -> 은빛소나무 숲 -> 타렌 밀
steps.text: 언더시티에서 티리스팔 숲과 은빛소나무 숲을 지나 남쪽으로 이동한 뒤, 힐스브래드 구릉지로 들어가 타렌 밀까지 가세요.

steps.title: 타렌 밀 -> 아라시 고원
steps.text: 길을 따라 동쪽으로 아라시 고원에 들어간 뒤, 큰 돌다리를 향해 남쪽으로 따라가세요.

steps.title: 탄돌 교 (아라시 고원 / 저습지 경계)
steps.text: 이 거대한 다리는 협곡을 건너 저습지로 이어지며, 얼라이언스 영토로 들어가는 관문입니다.

steps.title: 저습지
steps.text: 남동쪽으로 향하는 큰길을 따라가세요. 길이 가장 안전하니 끝까지 길을 벗어나지 마세요.

steps.title: 던 알가즈 (저습지 / 모단 호수 경계)
steps.text: 이 산길은 모단 호수로 이어집니다. 검문소에 얼라이언스 경비병이 있으니 멈추지 말고 속도로 통과하세요.

steps.title: 모단 호수 -> 던 모로
steps.text: 모단 호수와 던 모로를 잇는 터널로 서쪽으로 가세요. 관문을 계속 지나 아이언포지를 향해 서쪽으로 이동하세요.

steps.title: 아이언포지에 들어가기 전 (던 모로)
steps.text: 장비를 벗으세요. 경비병에게 몇 번 죽을 가능성이 높은데, 착용하지 않은 장비는 내구도가 닳지 않습니다.

steps.title: 아이언포지
steps.text: 마그니 왕의 알현실인 왕좌로 가세요. 들어가면서 왼쪽의 거미줄로 덮인 통로(좌표 43.5, 52.0)로 들어가세요.

steps.title: 시체 찾기
steps.text: 영혼의 치유사가 도시 바로 밖에 있어서 죽을 때마다 조금만 달리면 됩니다. 경비병 눈에 띄지 않는 조용한 구석에서 부활해 매번 조금씩 전진하세요.

steps.title: 옛 아이언포지
steps.text: 구불구불한 계단과 돌길을 따라 아래로 내려가세요. 길 끝에는 퀘스트 제공자 톰 필치와 던전 입구가 있는 용암 위의 다리가 있습니다.

steps.title: Если вы не Нежить, отправляйтесь на дирижабле из Оргриммара в Подгород

map.label: Дирижабль в Подгород
map.detail: Дирижабль в Подгород причаливает к башне у Оргриммара. Если не уверены, какой нужен, спросите Фреззу.

steps.title: Подгород -> Серебряный бор -> Мельница Таррен
steps.text: Отправляйтесь на юг из Подгорода через Тирисфальские леса и Серебряный бор, затем продолжайте путь в Предгорья Хилсбрада, пока не доберетесь до Мельницы Таррен.

steps.title: Мельница Таррен -> Нагорье Арати
steps.text: Двигайтесь по дороге на восток в Нагорье Арати, затем следуйте по ней на юг к большому каменному мосту.

steps.title: Мост Тандола (Нагорье Арати / Болотина)
steps.text: Этот огромный мост пересекает ущелье и ведет в Болотину. Здесь начинается территория Альянса.

steps.title: Болотина
steps.text: Держитесь главной дороги и двигайтесь на юго-восток. Это самый безопасный путь, поэтому не сходите с дороги.

steps.title: Дун Альгаз (Болотина / Лок Модан)
steps.text: Этот горный проход ведет в Лок Модан. На заставе стоят стражники Альянса, поэтому продолжайте бежать и постарайтесь пройти ее без остановки.

steps.title: Лок Модан -> Дун Морог
steps.text: Направляйтесь на запад к туннелю, соединяющему Лок Модан и Дун Морог. Пройдите через ворота и продолжайте двигаться на запад к Стальгорну.

steps.title: Перед входом в Стальгорн (Дун Морог)
steps.text: Снимите экипировку. Стражники, скорее всего, убьют вас несколько раз, а снятые предметы не теряют прочность.

steps.title: Стальгорн
steps.text: Направляйтесь в Палату Совета, к тронному залу короля Магни. Войдя внутрь, сверните в покрытый паутиной коридор слева, у координат 43.5, 52.0.

steps.title: Пробежка от кладбища
steps.text: Целитель душ находится прямо у города, поэтому после каждой смерти бежать обратно недалеко. Воскрешайтесь в тихих углах вне поля зрения стражников, чтобы с каждой попыткой продвигаться дальше.

steps.title: Старый Стальгорн
steps.text: Спускайтесь по извилистым лестницам и каменным дорожкам. Путь заканчивается у моста над лавой, где находятся квестодатель Thom Filch и портал в подземелье.

entrance.detail: Inside the Scarlet Monastery; the Library has its own portal door

bosses.name: Houndmaster Loksey
bosses.description: In the Huntsman's Cloister.

bosses.name: Arcanist Doan
bosses.description: Final boss, in the Athenaeum. Doan's Strongbox behind him holds The Scarlet Key.

quests.objective: Retrieve Mythology of the Titans from the Monastery and bring it to Librarian Mae Paledust in Ironforge.

quests.objective: Retrieve The Lost Magic of the Runemasters from the Scarlet Monastery.
quests.note: New in Forever. The book is held by Arcanist Doan.

quests.name: Compendium of the Fallen
quests.objective: Retrieve the Compendium of the Fallen from the Monastery and return to Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.
quests.warning: Undead cannot take this quest

quests.name: Final Passage
quests.warning: This is a long chain that has a step in the Library
quests.objective: Speak to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Into The Scarlet Monastery
quests.objective: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Varimathras in the Undercity.
quests.note: Herod is in the Armory; Loksey in the Library; Mograine and Whitemane in the Cathedral.

quests.name: Brother Anton
quests.warning: OPTIONAL, not required
quests.objective: Speak with Brother Anton in Desolace.
quests.pickup: Brother Crowley, Cathedral of Light, Stormwind
quests.note: Introductory step leading to In the Name of the Light.

quests.name: In the Name of the Light
quests.rewardSummary: Stormwind +200  •  Alliance +50  •  Darnassus +50  •  Ironforge +50  •  Gnomeregan Exiles +50
quests.objective: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Raleigh the Devout in Southshore.
quests.note:
Herod is in the Armory; Loksey in the Library; Mograine and Whitemane in the Cathedral.

bosses.name: Skul
bosses.description: Rare spawn near the entrance.

bosses.name: Hearthsinger Forresten
bosses.description: Rare spawn in one of the houses on Festival Lane.

bosses.name: The Unforgiven
bosses.description: Ghost in the square past the gate, surrounded by spectral citizens.

bosses.name: Timmy the Cruel
bosses.description: Appears in Crusaders' Square once the Scourge there are cleared.

bosses.name: Malor the Zealous

tip: From Malor's Strongbox, next to Malor the Zealous

bosses.description: In the Scarlet Bastion, past Timmy. Optional: next to him stands Malor's Strongbox with the Medallion of Faith for The Medallion of Faith (Aurius, at the start of the Undead side).

bosses.name: Postmaster Malown
bosses.description: Summoned by opening the three mailboxes with the Key to the City.

bosses.name: Ezra Grimm
bosses.description: The smoke shop's keeper. Clear the shop and touch the box of tobacco, and he comes for it (The Great Fras Siabi).

bosses.name: Cannon Master Willey
bosses.description: On Market Row, in front of the Scarlet Bastion.

bosses.name: Archivist Galford

bosses.name: Balnazzar
bosses.description: Final boss: Grand Crusader Dathrohan in the Hall of Lights turns into the dreadlord Balnazzar. Drops the Head of Balnazzar.

bosses.name: Jarien and Sothos
bosses.description: Summoned in Balnazzar's chamber, after the last boss, with the Brazier from the Dungeon Set 2 quests: they drop the pieces of Lord Valthalak's Amulet, and their loot is in the chest they leave.

entrance.detail: North-west Eastern Plaguelands: the main gate of Stratholme

quests.name: The Archivist
quests.turnin: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
quests.objective: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.
quests.pickup: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
quests.note: Kill Archivist Galford in the Scarlet Bastion and burn the archives.

startItem: Dropped by Balnazzar (hand in The Archivist first)

quests.objective: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Truth Comes Crashing Down
The Flesh Does Not Lie

quests.objective: Recover 20 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.
quests.pickup: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands

quests.name: Houses of the Holy
quests.turnin: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
quests.objective: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.
quests.pickup: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
quests.note: Collect 5 Stratholme Holy Water from the supply crates in the streets; some crates spawn enemies.

quests.name: The Great Fras Siabi

quests.objective: Find Fras Siabi's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Siabi's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.
quests.pickup: Smokey LaRue, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
quests.note: Newer Classic records call him Ezra Grimm. Clear the smoke shop, touch the tobacco box and kill the shopkeeper.

quests.name: Of Love and Family
quests.objective: Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world. Return the painting to Tirion Fordring.
quests.pickup: Artist Renfray, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
quests.note: Take the painting hidden behind the twin-moons picture in Archivist Galford's room before you burn the archives.

quests.name: The Medallion of Faith
quests.objective: Retrieve the Medallion of Faith from Malor the Zealous in the Scarlet Bastion and bring it back to Aurius.
quests.note: Malor's Strongbox in the Scarlet Bastion holds the medallion. Give it to Aurius in the chapel before fighting the Baron.

quests.objective: Retrieve the Medallion of Faith from Malor the Zealous in the Scarlet Bastion and bring it back to Aurius.
quests.note: Repeatable, after the first The Medallion of Faith.

quests.name: The Restless Souls

quests.pickup: Caretaker Alen, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands

quests.name: The Restless Souls
quests.objective: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs! Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

Stratholme: Living.description: The main gate of Stratholme: the burning streets, the Scarlet Bastion and the Hall of Lights, where Grand Crusader Dathrohan reveals himself as the dreadlord Balnazzar.

bosses.name: Kroog
